"No Snow, No Show" for the Eskimo
is a
live album
by
The Mission
released in 1993. It was recorded at two shows (at Wembley Arena on 2 December 1988 and at Manchester Apollo on 15 March 1990) for the
BBC
and was broadcast live by
BBC Radio One
.
[
1
]
These recordings were compiled by
Wayne Hussey
and Joe Gibb.
[
2
]
[
3
]
In 2008 all tracks, except for numbers 6, 8 and 9, and more from both concerts, were released as part of the
Live at the BBC
boxset.
The Eskimo in the title refers to an early name for the die-hard Mission fans who would follow them around the world on tour. One member, Ramone, reported that when he was frisked by the border patrol in a European country, the guard shook his head at him and uttered something in his native language, which to Ramone sounded like Eskimo.
